_doc: Model key -> GLB under public/models/. Lanes A and B add files; the loader falls back to a stand-in when a file is missing. scale/yOffset tune placement without code changes.

stormspawn.note: faces +Z; glow = lightning eyes and veins, emissiveMap set, emissive colour black: set material.emissive to white (intensity 1-3) to light it

waystone.note: carved face toward +Z; glow = inlaid wind lanes, emissiveMap set, emissive colour black: set material.emissive to white (intensity 1-3) to relight it

camp.note: earth patch 6 m across; unlit firewood at origin, fire effect in code

jetty.note: long axis X; deck about 2 m up, posts reach y=0; skiff moored alongside

bridge.note: runs along X from -3 to +3; tile every 6 m

underside.note: flat top at y=0, hangs down to y=-105.5

shard.note: glow = crystal, emissiveMap set, ships lit (emissive white)
